page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.hfg6 family. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 16 physical Intel Xeon 8269CY processor cores running at a base frequency of 3.1 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of memory per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark results place the ecs.hfg6.8xlarge in the average performance tier across multiple tests. The Intel Xeon processor delivers a single-core stress-ng score of 1436.68 and a multi-core score of 30666.35. In memory operations, the instance achieves a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 1705.41 GB/sec, which drops to 109.89 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, alongside a write bandwidth of 48.22 GB/sec. For specialized tasks, the server records a Geekbench multi-core score of 11107.0, with specific sub-test scores of 23704.0 for software compilation with Clang and 23493.0 for ray tracing.

The lack of local NVMe storage and GPU acceleration limits this instance's utility for heavy database caching or deep learning training. However, its dedicated CPU allocation and AVX-512 instruction support provide stable compute performance. In terms of qualitative cost efficiency, the 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offers a balanced resource density for general enterprise workloads. The instance is suited for multi-threaded applications, static web serving (benchmarked at 21.45 GB/sec), Redis key-value stores (achieving 28.91 million SET operations per second), and moderate LLM inference tasks, where it processes 12.4 text generation tokens per second on a 7B parameter model.
